name: Feature Delivery & Contribution SOP
description: Autonomous end-to-end delivery workflow implementing the contribution SOP: branch isolation, minimal edits, verification checks, conventional commit, and PR creation.

steps.title: Check branch & isolate
steps.description: Verify current git branch; ensure work is on a dedicated scoped branch (feat/, fix/, docs/, chore/) rather than main.

steps.title: Gather context & routing
steps.description: Consult canonical docs/ and root markdown files to establish requirements and determine if an ADR is needed.

steps.title: Implement minimal coherent change
steps.description: Apply targeted, focused changes keeping unrelated modifications out of the branch.

steps.title: Execute local verification suite
steps.description: Run sanitize.py, build_registry.py, validate_registry.py, manage_adr.py validate, and test suite.

steps.title: Stage and conventional commit
steps.description: Stage affected files and produce a structured conventional commit message.

steps.title: Push and open Pull Request
steps.description: Push branch to origin and create a PR with structured summary, scope, and verification evidence.
